segments.he: לְדִבְרֵי חֲכָמִים, אֶרֶס נָחָשׁ מֵעַצְמוֹ הוּא מֵקִיא. לְפִיכָךְ: נָחָשׁ בִּסְקִילָה, וְהַמַּכִּישׁ פָּטוּר.
segments.en: «According to the statement of the Rabbis, venom of a snake is discharged by» the snake «itself.» The snake directly causes the death, while the individual who imbeds the fang is merely an indirect cause. «Consequently, the snake» is executed «by stoning, and the one who caused» the snake to «bite» is «exempt» from execution.

moves.summary: per the Rabbis the snake discharges the venom itself, so the snake is stoned and the imbedder exempt
moves.about: the Rabbis exempt the imbedder because venom is discharged by the snake itself
